datum: model free-surface datum; do not label as MLLW without a datum transform
source: NOAA NOS Operational Forecast Systems via noaa-ofs-pds

quality.grid_method: nearest wet ROMS rho cell; no extrapolation beyond 0.45 degrees
quality.notes: CBOFS/DBOFS zeta is total free-surface elevation and may include surge and river effects; depth-averaged ROMS u/v are included where available.
